This program is seeking sophomore students, including, without limitation, Black, Hispanic and Latino students, who are interested in exploring career opportunities at JPMorganChase. Inside the program What you'll do Over the course of five weeks, you will build your teamwork, problem-solving, and professional development skills through a tailored curriculum focused on financial services exposure and education. You will gain tangible skills that will translate into potential future opportunities. Who we're looking for We are looking for dynamic individuals from diverse backgrounds and perspectives to help us grow and position our businesses for the future. All sophomore students who are interested in the JPMorganChase fellowship program, regardless of background, are welcome to apply. What we offer Training Your work experience will be complemented with training designed to improve your leadership, technical, and professional skills. Career progression This opportunity will expose you to careers in financial services and includes hands-on experience and a project-based curriculum, designed to help you build a pathway to future employment opportunities.
